metric: reach of exposure on the merge-gate metric, in the gate's own camera
task: phase B3 plan 3 task 4, review fix round 2
thisFileIsAnIndex: The primary record is the six per-point files listed under points[], each of which is tools/delta_e.py's own native output and carries spots[], scored, compareTotal, skippedPoseVerification and population, exactly like the gate files this experiment is cited beside. Every mean below is read from those files, not hand-entered, and each one re-derives from its own per-spot list. Round 1 of this review shipped a hand-assembled file instead; it could not be audited from the repo alone and is superseded by this one.
question: Can ANY exposure bring serenity under the <=16.58 all-spot legacy ceiling? Round 0 inferred it across cameras; round 1 measured it but recorded it unauditably; this is the same measurement re-run so each point is self-verifying.
method: ONE page load, ?apt=serenity&measure=1&fov=legacy, full shipped post chain (bloom ENABLED, threshold 1.8, strength 0.1, radius 0.5), only renderer.toneMappingExposure changing between captures. delta_e.py is invoked as a child process between captures with the page held open, because separate loads would confound the comparison: materials.js randomises its procedural textures per load and the load-to-load spread (+-0.01 to +-0.04 dE) is larger than the whole 0.006 spread this experiment measures. Stale flat frames deleted before every capture and the count (11) asserted after.

preconditionsAsserted.gpu: ANGLE (Intel, Intel(R) UHD Graphics 630 (0x00003E9B) Direct3D11 vs_5_0 ps_5_0, D3D11)

notAFit: DIAGNOSTIC ONLY, run after 0.329 was chosen, committed and verified. The shipped value is the luminance fit and does not move; choosing an exposure because it scored better on dE2000 is the rule violation this phase exists to prevent. This file exists so the merge owner knows whether a passing exposure exists at all. It does not.
result: Every point is above the ceiling. The curve is a shallow U with its minimum at exposure 0.32 -- native mean 16.61, full precision 16.6104 -- against the shipped 0.329 at 16.6160 full precision. The best exposure anywhere in the neighbourhood is worth 0.0056: a sixth of the 0.03 shortfall and a seventh of this metric's repeat-run noise floor. Both ends rise. NO EXPOSURE PASSES THIS GATE.
reproducibility: Two independent page loads now agree across all six points to within 0.002 full precision (fullPrecisionMean_thisRun vs fullPrecisionMean_priorIndependentRun above): same U, same minimum location, same verdict. The prior run is the round-1 capture; its per-point numbers are kept here as corroboration, not as the record.
corroboration: Independently of this experiment, six committed readings sit above the ceiling across three tasks and two exposure values: serenity-b3-task2-fix1-allspots.json 16.60 and serenity-b3-task3-off-allspots.json 16.61 at the old 0.326, plus task 4's four runs at 0.329 (16.60, 16.62, 16.61, 16.60). Those are all native delta_e.py files too.
windingDefect: Measured against a render carrying the deferred grid() winding defect (8 of 12 wall faces backwards, bake.js). Re-run this when that fix lands.
